name: Country Dancing with Natalie - lessons and events
attribution: Some listings come from Country Dancing with Natalie. We write our own short summaries and link back to the original page.
description: Dance listings in Port Jefferson Station, Mastic, Massapequa and Bayport: country line dancing.
reviewNotes: Covered by hand on 2026-10-06 (issue #41): her weekly line dancing class at American Legion Post 432 in Port Jefferson Station (Tuesdays 7-8:45 PM; Monday instead in the week of the 2nd Tuesday) is a repeating event in src/content/events/natalie-boyle-line-dancing-port-jefferson-station.json, listed through January 31, 2027. Check her Lessons and Events pages again by 2026-11-01 and every month after. Not added because no day or time is given, or it could not be confirmed: Mastic Rec Center, Massapequa Berner Middle School, Bayport-Blue Point Library, Bunker Hill Taproom (Wantagh), Port Jefferson Library, the Ballroom Cowboy/Cowgirl studio (1355 Montauk Hwy), Franz Music Studio in Wading River ("back in fall", not on her October list), Riverhead Ciderhouse (every 2 weeks, "stay tuned for new dates"; the Ciderhouse website blocks our reader) and Dublin Deck Country Wednesdays (a summer series, not on her October list). Her Events page also lists other people's weekly nights; Deanna's Heritage Center classes come from the dancing-with-deanna source. Weekly schedule written in words with no dates. An editor adds it once as a repeating event in the CMS and checks the page each month. Catalog check 2026-10-03: Keep it because the lessons page gives public recurring Long Island line-dance times and venues.
